english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an organized team, especially at work or in a project.
Use this for a team of people working together toward a task or goal.
Use this for an organized team of people working together toward a common purpose.

examples.english: Our team has to hand in a report tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 我哋團隊聽日要交份報告。

examples.english: This crew worked together for three months and finally finished the project.
examples.traditional: 呢個團隊一齊做咗三個月，終於完成項目。

examples.traditional: 公司團隊一齊完成咗呢個項目。
